svg.title: VibeProteinAgent report snapshot
svg.desc: Curated SVG recreation of the redesigned VPA HTML report (light theme): sidebar with the VibeProteinAgent logo and scroll-spy nav, the candidate-review 3D structure viewer showing pLDDT-blue alpha-helix ribbons for binder cand_042 with a sequence track and download, colour-coded evidence-family metric bars, cross-candidate distribution cards with range sliders, and the workflow execution graph (PXDesign, Protein QC, ESM-3, Boltz-2, Rank designs).
svg.text: Binder chain A in complex with target chain B (22 aa).
Turn on Pick, then hover residues for an instant residue card.
